The '''Rodian rot-worm''' was a [[Parasite/Legends|parasitic]] [[Worm/Legends|worm]]<ref name="Rub a Grub" /> that shared its name with [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] and [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> located in the [[Savareen sector/Legends|Savareen sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="EAOC Rodia">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Tyrius system/Legends|Tyrius system]]</ref> as well as its [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Reptile/Legends|reptilians]].<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> Its name was also similar to that of [[rotworm]]s, which lived on the [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] planet [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]<ref name="GoF">''[[Galaxy of Fear: The Hunger]]''</ref> in the Outer Rim's [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]].<ref name="TEA" /> By [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|5.0}}</ref> excretions from [[Drutash grub/Legends|drutash grubs]]<ref name="Rub a Grub" /> that could be found on the planet [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]<ref name="XWing">''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref> in the Outer Rim's [[Brema sector/Legends|Brema sector]]<ref name="EAOC Sullust">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Sullust system/Legends|Sullust system]]</ref> were being used in folk medicine to cure parasitic infections such as that caused by the Rodian rot-worm.<ref name="Rub a Grub" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual affiliated with one of the sides in the ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sent a companion to investigate the scientific validity of that practice, with the latter individual subsequently collecting biochemical samples.<ref name="Rub a Grub" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Rodian rot-worm was mentioned in a Bionanalysis Crew Skill mission of [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']], a [[2016]] expansion for the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Rub a Grub" />
